newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds flat ahead of U.S. inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds flat ahead of U.S. inflation data.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat late morning Tuesday as the market looked to the release of U.S. producer price and consumer price inflation for direction.
"For the moment there is no defined trend," said a trader at a local bank.
The trader added that most players were going into Wednesday and Thursday's inflation reports with flat positions.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was flat at 92-1/2, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was down $0.01 at 115.29.

Another trader said the inflation reports would be "fundamental factors" for the U.S. Federal Reserve in deciding whether it hikes interest rates on May 20 and as such the local market was seen range-trading until their release.
